questions.question: The SI unit of force is:
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons (N).

questions.question: Which organ in the human body purifies blood?
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter and purify blood.

questions.question: The maximum strength of the Lok Sabha as per the Constitution is:
questions.explanation: The Constitution permits a maximum of 550 elected members in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of common salt?
questions.explanation: Common salt is sodium chloride, NaCl.

questions.question: Which schedule of the Constitution deals with anti-defection?
questions.explanation: The 10th Schedule contains the anti-defection provisions.

questions.question: The Ranji Trophy is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Ranji Trophy is a domestic first-class cricket competition.

questions.question: Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting?
questions.explanation: Vitamin K is required for blood clotting.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?
questions.explanation: Mars looks red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: Which amendment is known as the "Mini Constitution"?
questions.explanation: The 42nd Amendment (1976) is called the "Mini Constitution" for its sweeping changes.

questions.question: Who gave the slogan "Give me blood and I will give you freedom"?
questions.explanation: The slogan is associated with Subhash Chandra Bose.

questions.question: The Thomas Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Thomas Cup is a men’s international badminton team event.

questions.question: Which line divides the Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres?
questions.explanation: The Equator divides the Earth into two hemispheres.

questions.question: Which is the largest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest Indian state by area.

questions.question: The powerhouse of the cell is the:
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce energy (ATP), so they are the cell’s powerhouse.

questions.question: Which disease is caused by a deficiency of iodine?
questions.explanation: Iodine deficiency causes goitre.

questions.question: Who composed the song "Vande Mataram"?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote "Vande Mataram".

questions.question: Photosynthesis mainly takes place in the:
questions.explanation: Leaves contain chlorophyll where photosynthesis occurs.

questions.question: The term "GDP" stands for:
questions.explanation: GDP = Gross Domestic Product.

questions.question: Which tax was subsumed under GST?
questions.explanation: Service Tax (among others) was subsumed under GST.

An article costing ₹760 is sold at a 20% profit. Find the selling price.

questions.explanation: Total parts = 7. Each part = 63/7 = 9. Larger = 4 × 9 = 36.

questions.question: A train 150 m long crosses a pole in 9 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 12 days and B in 6 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/12 + 1/6 = 18/72. Time = 72/18 = 4 days.

questions.question: Find the value of √400.
After a 10% discount, an item costs ₹360. Find its marked price.
Find 20% of 50% of 1800.
Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 5 and their difference is 22. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 2 parts = 22, so each part = 11. Smaller = 3 × 11 = 33.

questions.question: A boat travels 34 km downstream in 2 hours. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 34/2 = 17 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 17 − 4 = 13 km/h.

questions.question: If today is Saturday, what day will it be after 80 days?
questions.explanation: 80 mod 7 = 3; Saturday + 3 = Tuesday.

questions.question: Which letter is 4th to the right of the 6th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 6th letter = F; 6 + 4 = 10th letter = J.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (9, 733), (5, 125), (6, 216), (2, 8)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 9³ = 729, not 733.

questions.question: In a row of 49 students, Ravi is 22nd from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 49 − 22 + 1 = 28.

questions.question: Find the next term: 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 3²…7². Next is 8² = 64.

questions.question: Find the next term: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 12, so 30 + 12 = 42.

questions.question: If STAR is coded as UVCT, how is DOG coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2. Applying the same to DOG gives FQI.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 4:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 4:00 the angle is 4 × 30° = 120°.

questions.question: A person walks 6 km East and then 8 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(6² + 8²) = √100 = 10 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 9 + 2 × 3.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 9 × 2 − 3 = 18 − 3 = 15.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 8, 16, 32, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×2: 32 × 2 = 64.

questions.question: Complete the series: H, K, N, Q, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 3 places, so the next is T.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 24, 31, 5, 11
questions.explanation: 11, 5, 31 are prime numbers; 24 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 3rd from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 3rd letter from the right is the 24th from the left = X.
